title: aster ovatus var. microcephalus
intro: Aster ovatus var. microcephalus, commonly known as the Microcephalus Aster, is a variety of flowering plant in the daisy family native to East Asia. It is a shrub-like perennial herb used in traditional medicine, known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aster ovatus var. microcephalus include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and treat respiratory issues such as coughs and colds, as well as its antiseptic and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
